experiment: E4 -- the order-21 group on three generations (SEED.md sections 3, 7.3; PLAN.md section 4 E4)

conventions.Rf: flip R flip^-1 (hexagon_check.py) = LNR A^[3] exactly
conventions.basis: 3: D-weights (1,2,4); 3bar: (6,5,3); 6,7,8: F21-adapted D-diagonal blocks [1,1',1'',3,3bar] with D, C standard on each block
conventions.1prime: chi_1'(d) = omega (LNR); d is conjugate to C, so chi_1'(C) = omega

data_used.masses: Huang & Zhou arXiv:2009.04851v2, MS-bar at M_Z (full SM); ratios with max(exp, 10%) relative error

calibration.quantity: seed Rf and Rf*D versus LNR triplet generators A, B (eqs. 22-23)
PSL(2,7) Kronecker products (all 14 products of non-trivial irreps)
branching SU(3) -> PSL(2,7), 11 irreps up to (2,2)
calibration.target: LNR table (dimension content; bars lost in the PDF text)

calibration.quantity: LNR octet generator A^[8] (Gell-Mann basis), all 64 entries

calibration.note: LNR act with row convention (their eq. 28); in the column convention used here their 1' and 1'' singlet combinations exchange (omega <-> omega^2); triplet CGs identical in both conventions

calibration.quantity: number of F21 invariants in 3x3x3barx3bar (LNR operator psi psi' xi xi')
LNR seesaw M_Maj, M_Dir, M_nu at alpha=beta=-1
alpha windows for r in [21.3, 45.1] (beta=-1, normal ordering)
theta13 with charged-lepton haze lambda_e = sqrt(me/mmu) (pole masses)

calibration.note: the sign of the haze rotation is the one in LNR's printed U_-1 (it reproduces all nine entries of their U_MNSP); the opposite sign gives 38.09 deg

findings.quantity: Schur: singular values of the general F21- (PSL-) invariant mass matrix for L=R=3 with a trivial scalar
findings.value: three equal (1 coupling); L=3,R=3bar: 0 couplings; Majorana 3x3x1: 0 couplings
findings.note: commutant of the triplet is 1-dimensional for both groups; a single 1, 1' or 1'' vev gives equal |masses|, any two of them already give three distinct masses (F21 broken to Z7)

findings.quantity: LNR integer point vs NuFIT 6.0: sin^2 theta13
LNR integer point vs NuFIT 6.0: Dm31^2/Dm21^2
LNR alpha refit to NuFIT ratio (beta=-1)
findings.note: mixing stays exactly tri-bimaximal (theta13 = 0) for every alpha; m3/m1 = 9 for every alpha

findings.quantity: F21: number of full-residual-symmetry mixing patterns
findings.value: 10 (sector, G_l, G_nu, |U|^2) combinations; 3 distinct |U|^2 structures up to row/column permutations

findings.quantity: F21: best full-residual-symmetry lepton pattern (0 mixing parameters, 4 obs.)
F21: best full-residual-symmetry CKM pattern (0 mixing parameters, 4 obs.)
PSL: number of full-residual-symmetry mixing patterns
findings.value: 97 (sector, G_l, G_nu, |U|^2) combinations; 26 distinct |U|^2 structures up to row/column permutations

findings.quantity: PSL: best full-residual-symmetry lepton pattern (0 mixing parameters, 4 obs.)
PSL: best full-residual-symmetry CKM pattern (0 mixing parameters, 4 obs.)
PSL(2,7) Z2-partial lepton class G_l=Z7, fixed column |U|^2=[0.131512, 0.204495, 0.663993]
PSL(2,7) Z2-partial lepton class G_l=Z3, fixed column |U|^2=[0.166667, 0.166667, 0.666667]
PSL(2,7) Z2-partial lepton class G_l=Z3, fixed column |U|^2=[0.333333, 0.333333, 0.333333]
F21 texture survey (LNR framework), complex couplings (161 classes): classes by verdict
findings.note: 0 predictive survivors; 37 accommodate with N_eff >= N_obs

findings.quantity: F21 texture survey, real (CP-conserving) couplings (144 classes; reconciliation): classes by verdict
findings.note: 3 predictive survivors (dof = 1): lepton|min-real|phi10=G|phi5=Z3|phi1=P chi2 0.902 (survey multistart; 0.140 after polishing from the delta branches, p 0.71); lepton|min-real|phi10=G|phi5=P|phi1=Z3 chi2 0.395 (survey multistart; 0.140 after polishing from the delta branches, p 0.71); lepton|min-real|phi10=G|phi5=P|phi1=P chi2 0.021 (survey multistart; 0.021 after polishing from the delta branches, p 0.89); 32 accommodate with N_eff >= N_obs. Each survivor's one prediction: delta on a discrete set of at least 16-22 branches spread over the whole circle (union [15.5, 26.1, 44.2, 61.1, 83.8, 85.3, 99.2, 122.5, 122.6, 123.9, 131.3, 138.9, 152.3, 207.7, 221.1, 228.7, 236.1, 237.4, 260.8, 274.7, 276.2, 298.9, 315.8, 333.9, 344.5]); nearest to NuFIT's 177 deg: 152.3 and 207.7 deg

texture_survey_coupling_convention: complex couplings (alpha, beta in 'min'; all c_k, alpha in 'gen'); 'LNR exact' has real alpha. The real-coupling variants (min-real, gen-real) are reported separately (reconciliation).
texture_survey_rule: N_eff = generic rank of d(obs)/d(params); dof = N_obs - N_eff; dof >= 1: SURVIVES if p > 0.01; dof <= 0: 'accommodates (no prediction)' if chi2 < 1 else excluded (fixed before fitting)
